instruction:
Rework the change "Run the SEO check to identify the 263 pages missing og:image and 98 pages missing description. For each page, add appropriate Open Graph image (1200x630) and me" (chg_e5f8aa65), rejected at review with this feedback:

"beta regression: checks score 0.72 in the change, 0.75 on the workspace"

The change set out to: Run the SEO check to identify the 263 pages missing og:image and 98 pages missing description. For each page, add appropriate Open Graph image (1200x630) and meta description (150-160 chars) in the front matter or template. Verify with `python3 .benzene/checks/material.py seo` until it passes. Target: material.seo bar passes (0 og-image failures, 0 description failures).
Build it again so it answers the feedback; it is reviewed again before it lands.

- cio: verify:pitch, verify:pitch-structure, verify:pitch-completion-minimums, verify:traction

## What a step is
Work in the workspace's files, done by a cell with the workspace tools. No step runs a command or a check, commits, pushes, opens or updates a pull request or its status, publishes, or waits for a person's answer: the organisation runs the checks after each step, records the work and publishes it itself. The file work such an ask contains (the post, the fix, the note) is a step; only the rest is left out. When nothing remains, the plan has no steps and its problem says why.
